race.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post And Win' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: ATTIN and Jet of Stars both looked good when winning bumpers in the spring. Slight preference is for the former, as Jet of Stars must prove his well-being after suffering a health problem on his hurdles bow. Penalised winner Moon Reign is the only other realistic contender. ATTIN (FR) JET OF STARS (IRE) MOON REIGN
